title: Flatness of the quotient after localized base change
statement: Let $R,S,R',S'$ be commutative rings with algebra maps $R\to S$, $R\to R'$, $S\to S'$, $R'\to S'$ and compatible scalar towers giving the same map $R\to S'$. Let $I$ be an ideal of $R$ and $M$ an $S$-module with its compatible restricted $R$-action. Suppose there are a ring map $q:S\otimes_R R'\to S'$ and a multiplicative subset $W\subset S\otimes_R R'$ such that $q(s\otimes r')$ equals the product of the images of $s$ and $r'$ and $q$ identifies $S'$ with the localization at $W$ [lem-weil-pbc-localization-module-exact]. Put $J=IR'$, the image ideal, and $M'=S'\otimes_S M$. If $(R/I)\otimes_R M$ is flat over $R/I$ [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map], then $(R'/J)\otimes_{R'} M'$ is flat over $R'/J$. No locality, Noetherianity, finiteness, or properness assumption is made.

source.place: Algebra, Tag 00MO (lemma-another-variant-local-criterion-flatness), first proof paragraph; quotient flatness before and after localization

proof.text: Put Q=R/I and Q'=R'/IR', construct the quotient algebra Q to Q'. Flat base change of Q tensor_R M and cancelBaseChange make Q' tensor_R M flat over Q'.

Put A=S tensor_R R', B=Q' tensor_R' A, D=Q' tensor_R' S'. The pure-tensor formula makes q R'-linear. Mathlib IsLocalization.tensorProduct_tensorProduct_right identifies D as localization of B. IsLocalizedModule.rTensor identifies D tensor_S M as localization of B tensor_S M.

Tensor cancellation gives B equiv C=Q' tensor_R S; preserve S and Q' actions by checking pure tensors. A proved private helper gives C tensor_S M equiv Q' tensor_R M, so B tensor_S M is Q'-flat. Localization preserves base flatness, making D tensor_S M Q'-flat. Tensor symmetry and AlgebraTensorModule.rightComm give the stated module equiv D tensor_S M; extend scalar linearity along the surjective quotient map R' to Q'.

theorem flat_quotient_localized_baseChange
    {R : Type u} {S : Type v} {R' : Type w} {S' : Type z}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [CommRing R'] [CommRing S']
    [Algebra R S] [Algebra R R'] [Algebra S S'] [Algebra R' S'] [Algebra R S']
    [IsScalarTower R S S'] [IsScalarTower R R' S']
    (I : Ideal R)
    (M : Type t) [AddCommGroup M] [Module S M] [Module R M]
    [IsScalarTower R S M]
    (hloc : ∃ (q : S ⊗[R] R' →+* S') (W : Submonoid (S ⊗[R] R')),
      (∀ (s : S) (r' : R'), q (s ⊗ₜ[R] r') =
        algebraMap S S' s * algebraMap R' S' r') ∧
      (letI := q.toAlgebra; IsLocalization W S'))
    (hquot : Module.Flat (R ⧸ I) ((R ⧸ I) ⊗[R] M)) :
    Module.Flat (R' ⧸ I.map (algebraMap R R'))
      ((R' ⧸ I.map (algebraMap R R')) ⊗[R'] (S' ⊗[S] M))
